questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
It was hard
Go to Melbourne with other Danes and find an Airbnb for 2 weeks. Find something together while in the airbnb

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer:
hard to find something, expect to pay at least 7000 DKK / month (but remember its just 4 months!)
also live in Fitzroy, brunswick, south bank or something if possible, its fine to commute to monash, the city isn ice

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I chose the cheap option of on-campus living and ended up moving after a week. rly small room

questions.answer: texted Rikki, made the process faster

questions.answer: Same as KU, a lot of work load, challenging and fun.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
How long were you on exchange? *
Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
FIT5136: Software Engineering. Really easy
FIT5137: Advanced Database Technology. Semi-easy
FIT5222: Planning & Automated Reasoning. My hardest but most fun course. Recommend!!!! U will create AI controllers for multi-agent Pacman XD 
FIT5226: Mulit-agent Systems. Disappointing tbh, a fine course. Surprising to me it had game theory, which was fun. But omg it was so chaotic, apparently u have to be there to present ur assignments which they didn't say in the start, kinda messes with your travel plans. However it's just 2 times + the mid-term test. Everyone did rly bad on the test but he stil gave ppl rly good grades. Just a chaotic course tbh but the content was fine

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Of those I took:
FIT5222 > FIT5137 > FIT5226 > FIT5136

FIT5136 is just so boring, too easy and just about planning how to do software and then doing a simple application in python or java xd
